rules: A citation string is attribution until it resolves to a BYTES_VERIFIED register record whose temporal coverage contains the claimed interval
BYTES_VERIFIED requires a pinned payload SHA-256, a resolvable locator, and explicit temporal/spatial coverage
METADATA_VERIFIED records prove a source exists and its terms; they never satisfy event-evidence or control-evidence checks
UNRESOLVED records are bookkeeping for known-but-unverified references
reviewer_ids anywhere in the pipeline are attribution strings, not authenticated identities
This register authorizes no weather, satellite, or seismic acquisition
